Extract item scores from a fitted PCA/varimax model

Source: R/s3.R
scores.Rd

Extract item scores from a fitted PCA/varimax model

Usage

scores(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Object to dispatch on

...

Passed to methods

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(42)
theta  = rdirichlet(50, 1, k = 3)
phi    = rdirichlet(3, 0.1, k = 20)
corpus = draw_corpus(rep(50L, 50), theta, phi)
model  = tmfast(corpus, n = 3)
scores(model, k = 3)
